name: freelance-structure
description: Just went freelance, needs structure to replace the rhythm of a team.
initial_prompt: I just went freelance after seven years at a big agency. I have two clients lined up so revenue isn't an emergency, but I'm realizing how much structure the team gave me. I keep working weird hours and then feeling guilty when I'm not working. I need a way to feel like I'm doing this on purpose.
scripted_user_replies: Day-to-day, I have client work that's just billable hours — I don't think those need to be 'goals'. The stuff I'd actually want goals for is: improving my craft, building a portfolio piece, and maybe seeding what comes after freelancing.
One week feels too short, two feels right. For accountability, I have a freelance friends Discord — three people I trust. None of them are in my exact field, which is probably good.
